title: Offer / paywall
one_line: STARTER PACK and NX CLUB. Must show price, billing period, renewal terms and the legal links - store-review requirements, not decoration.

anatomy.spec: Logotype (STARTER PACK or NX CLUB, bible 2.8).
Item icons with numbers, laid out as a well grid.
go green, the store's localised price - never hard-coded.
For a subscription (NX Club): billing period, auto-renewal terms, and links to Terms and Privacy, all live text, all legible at 12 pt or more.

states: One-time offer, already purchased - banner and popup both disappear from the shop
Subscription, active - shows manage/cancel instead of buy
data: RevenueCat offering for price, period and entitlement state. Never a hard-coded price or period.

assets_needed.name: logo_starterpack
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P1-3: STARTER PACK logotype, same style as VICTORY!.

assets_needed.name: logo_nxclub
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P1-3: NX CLUB logotype, same style as VICTORY!.

do_not: Do not hard-code a price, period or renewal term.
Do not omit the auto-renewal terms or the Terms/Privacy links on a subscription - Apple and Google both require this and will reject the build without it.
Do not keep showing a one-time offer's banner after it has been purchased.
acceptance: Price, period and renewal terms all come from RevenueCat.
A purchased one-time offer disappears from the shop.
An active subscription shows manage/cancel, not buy.
steps: 1. Preflight - depends on T-B2/T-B3 (RevenueCat webhook and offerings) being wired; can be built against a mock offering first.
2. Build the card with logotype, contents, value line.
3. Wire the price button, legal terms and restore link to RevenueCat.
5. Capture one-time and subscription, each state. Postflight.
prompt:
Build the Ludo NX Offer / paywall popup (STARTER PACK and NX CLUB).

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md section 6.14, UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7.4, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

This does not exist yet. Standard NX Card popup: a logotype header (STARTER PACK or NX CLUB), item contents as icons with numbers, a value line, and a go-green price button showing the RevenueCat offering's localised price - never hard-coded.

The part that gets an app rejected if skipped: for the NX Club subscription, the popup MUST show the billing period, the auto-renewal terms, and working links to Terms and Privacy, all live text and legible. Also add Restore purchases as a caption link, and handle the purchased/active-subscription states so a bought one-time offer's banner disappears from the shop and an active subscription shows manage/cancel instead of buy.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
